articles.title: Effects of Altitude or Hypoxic Exposure on Endurance Running Performance: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
articles.description: Altitude or hypoxic exposure appears to confer small improvements in time-trial performance in middle- and long-distance runners, whereas physiological responses are less consistent across outcomes and protocols.

articles.title: Rehabilitative and Conditioning Exercises That Selectively Activate Individual Lower Extremity Muscles: A Systematic Review
articles.description: Current literature reporting selective activation of individual lower extremity muscles exists, particularly for the biceps femoris, but there remains a paucity of literature exploring exercises that effectively isolate all muscle groups...

articles.title: Sleep Strategies and Performance Outcomes in Ultramarathon Runners: A Systematic Review
articles.description: Pre-race sleep extension was associated with faster finish times, although the observational evidence does not establish causality. Further research using objective sleep measures and controlled designs is required.
